+var environmentVariableReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}$`)
+
+// environmentVariableSubstitutionHookFunc replaces string values that consist
+// of a single ${VARIABLE_NAME} reference with the value of that environment
+// variable. Keeping this hook first allows later hooks to convert the resolved
+// value to the destination type.
+func environmentVariableSubstitutionHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(from, to reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from.Kind() != reflect.String {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		match := environmentVariableReference.FindStringSubmatch(data.(string))
+		if len(match) != 2 {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if value, ok := os.LookupEnv(match[1]); ok {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

item.text: The first test run exposed a Viper edge case: some source values are string-backed enum types, so checking only the reflected kind can still lead to an unsafe string assertion. I tightened the hook to accept only actual Go strings; the config tests now pass. I’m adding explicit coverage that the existing `FLIPT_...` key still takes precedence, then I’ll clean up dependency metadata changed by the Go command and inspect the diff.

+var environmentVariableReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}$`)
+
+// environmentVariableSubstitutionHookFunc replaces string values that consist
+// of a single ${VARIABLE_NAME} reference with the value of that environment
+// variable. Keeping this hook first allows later hooks to convert the resolved
+// value to the destination type.
+func environmentVariableSubstitutionHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(from, to reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		value, ok := data.(string)
+		if !ok || from.Kind() != reflect.String {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		match := environmentVariableReference.FindStringSubmatch(value)
+		if len(match) != 2 {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if value, ok := os.LookupEnv(match[1]); ok {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}
